symptoms: Docker environment variables passed via -e are ignored because .env overrides runtime variables
A required configuration variable is omitted from Zod validation, causing delayed runtime crashes instead of startup aborts
Backing services have silent localhost defaults that fail when running inside containerized production environments

root_causes.defect_1_env_override_inversion: dotenv was invoked with override: true or unconditional file loading that overwrites existing process.env variables injected by Docker/Kubernetes. True Twelve-Factor compliance requires process.env to always take precedence over local .env files.
root_causes.defect_2_unvalidated_runtime_dependency: A critical service credential was left off the schema or configured as optional with delayed access, defeating fail-fast boot protection.
root_causes.defect_3_silent_localhost_fallbacks: Specifying default values pointing to localhost (e.g. localhost:5432) for production backing dependencies. Inside a container, localhost points to the container's isolated network namespace, turning missing production config into confusing connection-refused errors.

remediation: Ensure dotenv only populates missing keys and never overrides existing process.env variables.
Declare all runtime dependencies in Zod schema with strict type and length assertions.
Eliminate dangerous localhost defaults for primary database and production backing services; make them strictly required.
